# Latest delivery

MarkVibe **0.1.0.69** was installed and launched on 2026-11-26 using the
per-user Windows Release x64 MSI. About opens after the command menu closes
and groups version, author, project links and diagnostics around the MarkVibe
illustration. Settings includes font previews, installed Nerd Font Mono
families and descriptions of both workspace options.

The MSI and portable ZIP run immediately with a compatible x64 Microsoft
.NET Runtime 10.0. If needed, install the x64 runtime separately from
[Microsoft](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0).

> **File name** `archive.md`<br>
> **Full path** `E:\vibekit\Apps\MarkVibe\.github\tasks\archive.md`<br>
> **Path relative to the MarkVibe application root** `.github/tasks/archive.md`
